shared_elements: cross-shaped form (vertical stroke crossed by a horizontal bar)
row of short repeated vertical strokes along a horizontal line
justification: Both surfaces show purely linear, schematic incised motifs built from long horizontals crossed by repeated short vertical strokes, and both contain a prominent cross-like form (the outstretched-armed figures in A, the mast-and-yard in B). But the subjects differ fundamentally: A depicts a pair of large frontal stick-figure humans with splayed arms and legs occupying the whole field, while B depicts a single sailing vessel with a gridded sail, hull and a band of triangles, with no human figures at all.
